an6.88:1.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṃ abhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ
an6.88:1.3: tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne na sussūsati na sotaṃ odahati na aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti anatthaṃ gaṇhāti atthaṃ riñcati ananulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato hoti
an6.88:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṃ abhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ.
an6.88:2.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṃ bhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattaṃ
an6.88:2.3: tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne sussūsati sotaṃ odahati aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti atthaṃ gaṇhāti anatthaṃ riñcati anulomikāya khantiyā samannāgato hoti
an6.88:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato suṇantopi saddhammaṃ bhabbo niyāmaṃ okkamituṃ kusalesu dhammesu sammattanti. 89
